text: G. Stanley Hall described adolescence as a period of:
explanation: Hall called adolescence a period of "storm and stress" because of rapid physical and emotional change.

text: Which of the following is a developmental task of adolescence according to Havighurst?
explanation: Emotional independence from parents is a central adolescent task; the others belong to infancy, childhood and old age.

text: A student's marks are far below what his measured intelligence would predict. This is called:
explanation: Underachievement is performance well below potential, unlike low ability.

text: A boy scolded by his teacher shouts at his younger brother at home. This defence mechanism is:
explanation: Displacement shifts an emotion from its real source to a safer, weaker target.

text: In Piaget's theory, abstract and hypothetical reasoning appears in the:
explanation: The formal operational stage begins at about 11 to 12 years.

text: A person who obeys rules mainly to maintain social order is at which level of Kohlberg's moral development?
explanation: The law-and-order orientation is a conventional-level stage.

text: Bruner's three modes of representing knowledge are:
explanation: Bruner: enactive (action), iconic (image), symbolic (language).

text: When learning one skill makes learning a second skill harder, the transfer is called:
explanation: Negative transfer means earlier learning hinders later learning.

text: Which of the following is an example of intrinsic motivation?
options: Studying out of curiosity about the subject
explanation: Intrinsic motivation comes from within; prizes, fear and approval are extrinsic.

text: Forgetting caused by new learning interfering with earlier learning is called:
explanation: Retroactive inhibition: new material interferes with old; proactive is the reverse.

text: Divergent thinking, closely linked to creativity, was emphasised by:
explanation: Guilford's Structure of Intellect model separates divergent from convergent production.

text: Which of the following is NOT a component of creativity measured by Torrance's tests?
explanation: Torrance measures fluency, flexibility, originality and elaboration.

text: In Pavlov's experiment, the bell that came to produce salivation after being paired with food was the:
explanation: A neutral stimulus that acquires the power to evoke a response is a conditioned stimulus.

text: Praising a student so that he repeats good behaviour is an example of:
explanation: Skinner: adding a pleasant consequence strengthens behaviour.

text: The gap between what a learner can do alone and what he can do with guidance is Vygotsky's:
explanation: This gap is the Zone of Proximal Development; scaffolding is the support given within it.

text: Children with an IQ above about 130 are usually classified as:
explanation: An IQ above about 130 is the usual cut-off for giftedness.

text: Inclusive education means:
options: Teaching children with disabilities only in special schools
Educating children with and without disabilities together in regular classrooms with support
explanation: Inclusion places all learners in the regular classroom with the supports they need.

text: A teacher who lets students discover ideas through guided activities acts as a:
explanation: A facilitator guides learning instead of simply telling.

text: A teacher who helps students deal with personal and emotional problems acts as a:
explanation: Helping with personal and emotional problems is the counsellor's role.

text: A teacher who lets pupils share in decisions about classroom activities is following which style?
explanation: Shared decision-making and participation mark the democratic style.

text: Evaluation at the end of a unit to grade pupils is:
explanation: Summative evaluation sums up achievement at the end of a unit or course.

text: Which of the following is a learner-centred method?
explanation: In the project method learners plan and carry out the work themselves.

text: In CCE, the word "comprehensive" refers to evaluating:
options: Only at the end of the year
explanation: Comprehensive evaluation covers the whole personality, not just scholastic results.

text: The best way to prevent most discipline problems in a classroom is to:
options: Keep students engaged in meaningful activities
explanation: Engaged learners rarely misbehave; prevention works better than punishment.

text: Emotional maturity in a teacher is best shown by:
options: Staying calm and handling conflict constructively
explanation: An emotionally mature teacher stays composed and resolves conflict constructively.

text: The RTE Act 2009 guarantees free and compulsory education to children aged:
explanation: The Act covers children of 6 to 14 years (Article 21A).

text: The NCF 2005 recommends that learning should move away from rote methods and be based on:
explanation: NCF 2005 stresses learner-constructed knowledge and reduced rote learning.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ നമ്മുടെ ഏറ്റവും നല്ല കൂട്ടുകാരാണ്. അവ ഒന്നും ആവശ്യപ്പെടാതെ അറിവു നൽകുന്നു. ഏകാന്തതയിൽ അവ നമുക്ക് കൂട്ടിരിക്കുന്നു. വായനാശീലമുള്ളവർക്ക് ഒരിക്കലും ഒറ്റപ്പെടൽ അനുഭവപ്പെടുകയില്ല.” ഈ ഭാഗത്തിന്റെ കേന്ദ്രാശയം എന്താണ്?
options: പുസ്തകങ്ങൾ അറിവും കൂട്ടും നൽകുന്ന നല്ല ചങ്ങാതിമാരാണ്
explanation: ആദ്യവാക്യവും അവസാനവാക്യവും ഈ ആശയമാണ് പറയുന്നത്.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “സമയം പാഴാക്കുന്നവർക്ക് ജീവിതത്തിൽ വിജയിക്കാൻ കഴിയില്ല. ഓരോ ദിവസവും നമുക്ക് ലഭിക്കുന്നത് ഇരുപത്തിനാല് മണിക്കൂർ മാത്രമാണ്. അത് ഫലപ്രദമായി ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നവർ ലക്ഷ്യത്തിലെത്തുന്നു.” ഖണ്ഡിക അനുസരിച്ച് ലക്ഷ്യത്തിലെത്തുന്നത് ആരാണ്?
explanation: അവസാനവാക്യത്തിൽ ഇത് വ്യക്തമായി പറയുന്നു.

text: ഖണ്ഡിക വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “മഴക്കാലം തുടങ്ങിയതോടെ കർഷകർ വയലിലേക്ക് ഇറങ്ങി. വിത്തുകൾ വിതച്ച് അവർ ആകാശത്തേക്ക് നോക്കി പ്രാർഥിച്ചു.” ‘ആകാശത്തേക്ക് നോക്കി പ്രാർഥിച്ചു’ എന്നതിൽ നിന്ന് മനസ്സിലാക്കാവുന്നത് എന്താണ്?
explanation: വിതച്ച ശേഷമുള്ള പ്രാർഥന നല്ല മഴയ്ക്കും വിളവിനും വേണ്ടിയാണ്.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “അമ്മയെന്നൊരു രണ്ടക്ഷരം, അമൃതിൻ നിറകുടമല്ലോ; അമ്മതൻ സ്നേഹം നമുക്കെന്നും ആശ്രയമായ് വിളങ്ങീടുന്നു.” ഈ വരികളിലെ ആശയം എന്താണ്?
explanation: അവസാന രണ്ടു വരികൾ അമ്മയുടെ സ്നേഹം ആശ്രയമാണെന്ന് പറയുന്നു.

text: വരികൾ വായിച്ച് ഉത്തരം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക: “പുലരി പൊൻകതിർ വീശി വന്നു, പൂക്കളെല്ലാം ചിരി തൂകി; കിളികൾ പാടി, കുയിലുമോതി, കാറ്റിൽ ഗന്ധം പരന്നു.” ഈ വരികൾ ഏത് സമയത്തെ വർണിക്കുന്നു?
explanation: ‘പുലരി’, ‘പൊൻകതിർ’, പാടുന്ന കിളികൾ എന്നിവ പ്രഭാതത്തെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

text: ‘അമ്മയെന്നൊരു രണ്ടക്ഷരം, അമൃതിൻ നിറകുടമല്ലോ’ എന്ന വരിയിലെ അലങ്കാരം ഏതാണ്?
explanation: ‘പോലെ’ പോലുള്ള പദമില്ലാതെ അമ്മയെ അമൃതിൻ നിറകുടമായി തന്നെ പറയുന്നതിനാൽ ഇത് രൂപകമാണ്.

text: ‘പുഴ’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പര്യായമല്ലാത്തത് ഏത്?
explanation: നദി, തടിനി, സരിത് എന്നിവ പുഴയുടെ പര്യായങ്ങളാണ്; സമുദ്രം കടലാണ്.

text: ‘ഉദയം’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതപദം ഏത്?
explanation: ഉദയത്തിന്റെ വിപരീതം അസ്തമയമാണ്.

text: ‘ദയയില്ലാത്തവൻ’ എന്നതിന് ഒറ്റപ്പദം ഏത്?
explanation: ദയയില്ലാത്തവൻ എന്നതിന്റെ ഒറ്റപ്പദം നിർദയൻ.

text: ‘കുട്ടി പുസ്തകം വായിച്ചു’ എന്ന വാക്യത്തിലെ ക്രിയ ഏത്?
explanation: പ്രവൃത്തിയെ സൂചിപ്പിക്കുന്ന പദമാണ് ക്രിയ.

text: ഉചിതമായ പദം ചേർത്ത് വാക്യം പൂർത്തിയാക്കുക: “മഴ പെയ്തതിനാൽ ഞങ്ങൾ യാത്ര ......”
explanation: മഴ കാരണം യാത്ര മാറ്റിവെക്കുന്നു എന്നതാണ് യുക്തിസഹം.

text: താഴെ പറയുന്നവയിൽ ആജ്ഞാർഥ വാക്യം ഏത്?
explanation: ഒരു കാര്യം ചെയ്യാൻ കൽപ്പിക്കുന്ന വാക്യമാണ് ആജ്ഞാർഥം.

text: ‘കാണുക’ എന്ന ക്രിയയുടെ ഭൂതകാലരൂപം ഏത്?
explanation: ഭൂതകാലത്തിൽ ‘കണ്ടു’ എന്ന രൂപം വരുന്നു.

text: ‘തിരു + ഓണം = തിരുവോണം’ ഏത് സന്ധിക്ക് ഉദാഹരണമാണ്?
explanation: ഇവിടെ ‘വ്’ എന്ന വർണം പുതുതായി വരുന്നതിനാൽ ആഗമസന്ധിയാണ്.

text: ‘കണ്ണിൽ എണ്ണയൊഴിച്ച് കാത്തിരിക്കുക’ എന്ന ശൈലിയുടെ അർഥം ഏത്?
explanation: അതീവ ശ്രദ്ധയോടെയും ഉറക്കമൊഴിച്ചും കാത്തിരിക്കുക എന്നാണ് ഇതിന്റെ അർഥം.

text: ‘ചക്കിനു വെച്ചത് കൊക്കിനു കൊണ്ടു’ എന്ന പഴഞ്ചൊല്ലിന്റെ ആശയം ഏത്?
explanation: ഒരാൾക്കായി കരുതിയത് മറ്റൊരാൾക്ക് കിട്ടുന്ന സന്ദർഭത്തിൽ ഇത് ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.

text: ‘കുട്ടിയെ’ എന്ന പദം ഏത് വിഭക്തിയിലാണ്?
explanation: ‘-എ’ പ്രത്യയം വരുന്നത് പ്രതിഗ്രാഹിക വിഭക്തിയിലാണ്.

text: ‘കൃഷ്ണഗാഥ’ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: കൃഷ്ണഗാഥയുടെ കർത്താവ് ചെറുശ്ശേരിയാണ്.

text: ‘ഇന്ദുലേഖ’ എന്ന നോവൽ രചിച്ചതാര്?
explanation: ഇന്ദുലേഖ എഴുതിയത് ഒ. ചന്തുമേനോനാണ്.

text: ‘ഗായിക’ എന്ന പദത്തിന്റെ പുല്ലിംഗം ഏത്?
explanation: ‘ഗായിക’യുടെ പുല്ലിംഗം ‘ഗായകൻ’.

text: The speed of sound is greatest in:
explanation: Sound travels fastest in solids; it cannot travel through vacuum.

text: The siren of an approaching ambulance sounds higher in pitch than its actual pitch. This is due to the:
explanation: The relative motion of source and listener changes the apparent frequency.

text: An object is placed at the centre of curvature of a concave mirror of focal length 15 cm. The image distance is:
Total internal reflection can occur when light travels from:
options: Denser to rarer medium at an angle less than the critical angle
Denser to rarer medium at an angle greater than the critical angle
explanation: Both conditions are needed: denser to rarer and incidence beyond the critical angle.

text: Pascal's law is the working principle of a:
explanation: Pressure applied to a confined liquid is transmitted equally, which a hydraulic lift uses.

text: The heat needed to raise the temperature of 2 kg of water by 5 °C is (specific heat capacity of water = 4200 J/kg °C):
explanation: Q = mc(delta T) = 2 x 4200 x 5 = 42000 J.

text: A car starts from rest and reaches a velocity of 20 m/s in 5 s. Its acceleration is:
The recoil of a gun when a bullet is fired is an example of the law of:
explanation: Total momentum stays zero, so the gun moves backwards as the bullet moves forward.

text: The acceleration due to gravity on the moon is about what fraction of its value on the Earth?
explanation: The moon's surface gravity is about one-sixth of the Earth's.

text: The kinetic energy of a 2 kg body moving at 3 m/s is:
The equivalent resistance of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 6 Ω resistors connected in parallel is:
Which statement about magnetic field lines is correct?
options: They begin at the south pole and end at the north pole outside the magnet
explanation: Magnetic field lines are closed loops and never intersect.

text: Which of these materials is diamagnetic?
explanation: Bismuth is a diamagnetic material; iron, nickel and cobalt are ferromagnetic.

text: The device that converts mechanical energy into electrical energy is a:
explanation: A generator works on electromagnetic induction.

text: A transformer works on the principle of:
explanation: A changing current in the primary induces an emf in the secondary: mutual induction.

text: The majority charge carriers in a p-type semiconductor are:
explanation: Doping with trivalent atoms creates holes, the majority carriers in p-type material.

text: A junction diode is mainly used as a:
explanation: A diode conducts in one direction, so it converts AC to DC.

text: Which of the following processes is endothermic?
explanation: Photosynthesis absorbs energy from sunlight; the others release heat.

text: Rutherford's alpha-particle scattering experiment led to the discovery of the:
explanation: A few alpha particles were deflected sharply, showing a small, dense, positive nucleus.

text: The number of neutrons in an atom of sodium-23 (atomic number 11) is:
explanation: Neutrons = mass number - atomic number = 23 - 11 = 12.

text: Which of the following metals is the most reactive?
explanation: Sodium lies near the top of the reactivity series.

text: Rusting of iron requires:
explanation: Iron rusts when air (oxygen) and water are both present.

text: Which of the following is a colloid?
explanation: Milk is a colloid (an emulsion) in which fat globules are dispersed in water.

text: Oil and water, which do not mix, can be separated using a:
explanation: The denser liquid is run off through the tap of a separating funnel.

text: According to the Modern Periodic Law, properties of elements are periodic functions of their:
explanation: Moseley's modern periodic law uses atomic number.

text: Which element has the highest electronegativity?
explanation: Fluorine is the most electronegative element.

text: Which of the following compounds contains an ionic bond?
explanation: NaCl forms by transfer of an electron from sodium to chlorine.

text: The Haber process is used for the manufacture of:
explanation: Haber process: N₂ + 3H₂ gives 2NH₃.

text: Which allotrope of carbon conducts electricity?
explanation: Graphite has free electrons in its layers, so it conducts.

text: The number of covalent bonds a carbon atom forms in its compounds is:
explanation: Carbon is tetravalent.

text: The pH of lemon juice is most likely to be about:
explanation: Lemon juice contains citric acid, so its pH is low (about 2).

text: A gas occupies 4 L at 1 atm. At constant temperature, its volume at 2 atm will be:
explanation: Boyle's law: P1V1 = P2V2, so V2 = 4 x 1 / 2 = 2 L.

text: The number of moles in 36 g of water (H = 1, O = 16) is:
explanation: Molar mass of water is 18 g, so 36 / 18 = 2 mol.

text: Who is regarded as the father of the Indian space programme?
explanation: Vikram Sarabhai started India's space research; Bhabha is associated with the nuclear programme.

text: In the original Bloom's taxonomy of the cognitive domain, the highest level is:
explanation: The original order is knowledge, comprehension, application, analysis, synthesis, evaluation.

text: Which of the following is a science process skill?
explanation: Observing, classifying, measuring, inferring and predicting are process skills.

text: The objective "the pupil sets up the apparatus to study the image formed by a convex lens" belongs to the:
explanation: Setting up and handling apparatus is a manipulative skill, so it is psychomotor.

text: According to constructivism, knowledge is:
explanation: Learners construct knowledge from their experiences.

text: Discovery learning is most closely associated with:
explanation: Bruner promoted discovery learning.

text: The last step in the Herbartian lesson plan is:
explanation: Herbart's steps: preparation, presentation, comparison, generalisation, application.

text: Which of the following is a projected aid?
explanation: Projected aids need a projector to show the content on a screen.

text: The Inquiry Training Model was developed by:
explanation: Suchman designed the Inquiry Training Model to teach scientific inquiry.

text: The concept attainment model of teaching is based on the work of:
explanation: The concept attainment model builds on Bruner's study of thinking.

text: The heuristic method of teaching science was introduced by:
explanation: Armstrong's heuristic method lets pupils find things out for themselves.

text: Moving from particular examples to a general rule is the essence of the:
explanation: Induction goes from examples to the rule.

text: The project method was popularised by:
explanation: Kilpatrick developed the project method from Dewey's ideas.

text: An approach that links science with other subjects such as mathematics and social science is called:
explanation: The interdisciplinary approach connects content across subjects.

text: A curriculum in which the same topic is revisited at increasing levels of depth is called a:
explanation: Bruner proposed the spiral curriculum.

text: A book that guides the teacher in planning and teaching a textbook is called a:
explanation: The teacher's handbook accompanies the pupils' textbook.

text: The primary aim of laboratory work in science teaching is to:
options: Develop skills and scientific attitude through experience
explanation: Laboratory work builds skills, attitudes and understanding.

text: A diagnostic test is used to:
explanation: It locates specific weaknesses so remedial teaching can follow.

text: Evaluation carried out during the teaching-learning process to improve learning is:
explanation: Formative evaluation gives feedback while learning is going on.

text: Action research by a teacher is carried out mainly to:
options: Solve problems in his or her own classroom
explanation: Action research is a practical, classroom-based inquiry to improve practice.
